safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting follow-up as “in a few days” instead of the gold plan of review in 24–48 hours could delay reassessment if symptoms persist/worsen, which matters for potentially evolving serious causes of lower abdominal pain (e.g., appendicitis, ectopic pregnancy, complicated UTI). A delayed review window can worsen outcomes by postponing escalation, imaging, or urgent referral.
